guide.title: Binding Guide
guide.step1: Log in to the WeCom admin console (work.weixin.qq.com), create a self-built app under 'App Management', and note its AgentId and Secret.
guide.step2: Find the Corp ID at the bottom of the 'My Company' page, then fill CorpId / AgentId / Secret into the form above.
guide.step3: In the self-built app's 'WeCom Authorization Login' section, configure the trusted domain and set the callback to the 'Callback URL' above.
guide.step4: Bind WeCom member UserIds to local accounts: admins can review accounts in User Management and maintain the binding in the sys_user.wecom_userid column (a UI for binding is planned).
guide.step5: Turn on 'Enable QR Login' and save — the WeCom QR entry appears on the login page, and members can sign in by scanning.
